<?php
// api/decrypt_service.php - REST API with circuit breaker for downstream crypto service

class CircuitBreaker {
    private $failureCount = 0;
    private $threshold;
    private $resetTimeout;
    private $lastFailureTime = 0;
    private $state = 'CLOSED';

    public function __construct(int $threshold = 5, int $resetTimeout = 30) {
        $this->threshold = $threshold;
        $this->resetTimeout = $resetTimeout;
    }

    public function getState(): string {
        if ($this->state === 'OPEN' && (time() - $this->lastFailureTime) > $this->resetTimeout) {
            $this->state = 'HALF_OPEN';
        }
        return $this->state;
    }

    public function recordSuccess(): void {
        $this->failureCount = 0;
        $this->state = 'CLOSED';
    }

    public function recordFailure(): void {
        $this->failureCount++;
        $this->lastFailureTime = time();
        if ($this->failureCount >= $this->threshold) {
            $this->state = 'OPEN';
        }
    }

    public function isAvailable(): bool {
        return $this->getState() !== 'OPEN';
    }
}

class CryptoService {
    private $key;
    private $circuitBreaker;

    public function __construct(string $key, CircuitBreaker $cb) {
        $this->key = $key;
        $this->circuitBreaker = $cb;
    }

    public function decrypt(string $ciphertext): array {
        if (!$this->circuitBreaker->isAvailable()) {
            return ['error' => 'service_unavailable', 'code' => 503];
        }

        try {
            $result = $this->performDecryption($ciphertext);
            $this->circuitBreaker->recordSuccess();
            return $result;
        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            $this->circuitBreaker->recordFailure();
            return ['error' => 'decryption_failed', 'code' => 500];
        }
    }

    private function performDecryption(string $ciphertext): array {
        $raw = base64_decode($ciphertext, true);
        if ($raw === false || strlen($raw) < 32) {
            throw new \InvalidArgumentException('Invalid ciphertext format');
        }

        $iv = substr($raw, 0, 16);
        $encrypted = substr($raw, 16);

        if (strlen($encrypted) % 16 !== 0) {
            throw new \InvalidArgumentException('Invalid ciphertext alignment');
        }

        // Decrypt using AES-128-CBC
        $decrypted = openssl_decrypt(
            $encrypted,
            'aes-128-cbc',
            $this->key,
            OPENSSL_RAW_DATA | OPENSSL_ZERO_PADDING,
            $iv
        );

        if ($decrypted === false) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('OpenSSL decryption error');
        }

        // Validate and remove PKCS7 padding
        $paddingValidation = $this->validatePkcs7Padding($decrypted);
        if ($paddingValidation['valid'] === false) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Padding validation failed');
        }

        $plaintext = $paddingValidation['data'];

        // Verify data integrity with embedded HMAC
        if (strlen($plaintext) < 32) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Data too short for integrity check');
        }

        $hmac = substr($plaintext, 0, 32);
        $payload = substr($plaintext, 32);
        $expectedHmac = hash_hmac('sha256', $payload, $this->key, true);

        if (!hash_equals($hmac, $expectedHmac)) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Integrity check failed');
        }

        return ['data' => $payload, 'code' => 200];
    }

    private function validatePkcs7Padding(string $data): array {
        $length = strlen($data);
        $padByte = ord($data[$length - 1]);

        if ($padByte < 1 || $padByte > 16) {
            return ['valid' => false, 'data' => null];
        }

        for ($i = $length - $padByte; $i < $length; $i++) {
            if (ord($data[$i]) !== $padByte) {
                return ['valid' => false, 'data' => null];
            }
        }

        return ['valid' => true, 'data' => substr($data, 0, $length - $padByte)];
    }
}

class ApiController {
    private $cryptoService;

    public function __construct(CryptoService $service) {
        $this->cryptoService = $service;
    }

    public function handleRequest(): void {
        header('Content-Type: application/json');

        if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] !== 'POST') {
            $this->sendResponse(['error' => 'method_not_allowed'], 405);
            return;
        }

        $input = json_decode(file_get_contents('php://input'), true);
        if (!isset($input['token'])) {
            $this->sendResponse(['error' => 'missing_token'], 400);
            return;
        }

        $startTime = hrtime(true);
        $result = $this->cryptoService->decrypt($input['token']);
        $elapsed = hrtime(true) - $startTime;

        $code = $result['code'];
        unset($result['code']);

        // Include timing for monitoring/SLA compliance
        $result['processing_time_ns'] = $elapsed;

        $this->sendResponse($result, $code);
    }

    private function sendResponse(array $data, int $httpCode): void {
        http_response_code($httpCode);
        echo json_encode($data);
    }
}

// Bootstrap
$encryptionKey = getenv('APP_ENCRYPTION_KEY') ?: str_repeat('\x00', 16);
$cb = new CircuitBreaker(5, 30);
$service = new CryptoService($encryptionKey, $cb);
$controller = new ApiController($service);
$controller->handleRequest();
